title: Video to MP3 & Audio Converter
summary: MP4 to MP3, extract audio from videos, trim & denoise. Make ringtones
description:
Got a video with audio you want as a separate file? Need to convert a song from FLAC to MP3 for your car? This all-in-one audio converter and video to MP3 extractor handles both tasks effortlessly. Supports over 20 formats including MP4, MOV, MP3, WAV, FLAC, AAC, OGG, WMA, M4A, ALAC, AIFF, AMR, AC3, Opus, CAF, DTS, WV, OGA, W64, VOC, SPX, IRCAM, MP2, GSM, and more. Import via Files, Photos, Music, or Wi-Fi transfer, then convert or extract with just a tap.

KEY FEATURES

• Audio Format Converter – Convert any audio file to MP3, WAV, FLAC, AAC, OGG, M4A, and many other formats. Keep original quality or choose compression level.
• Video to Audio Extractor – Extract audio track from MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV, and other video files. Save as standalone MP3, WAV, or any supported format.
• Audio Trimmer – Cut and trim audio clips precisely. Remove unwanted sections or keep only the best part.
• Volume Booster – Increase loudness, normalize volume across tracks for consistent listening.
• Speed & Pitch Changer – Change playback speed without altering pitch, or shift pitch without affecting tempo. Perfect for language learning or music practice.
• Fade In / Fade Out – Apply smooth volume transitions at start or end of audio files.
• Equalizer – Adjust frequency bands with a multi-band EQ. Use presets or create custom curves.
• Reverb & Echo Effects – Add spatial ambiance to make audio sound like a concert hall or studio.
• Noise Reduction – Remove background hiss, wind, hum, and other unwanted noise. Clean up recordings from café, traffic, or outdoor settings.
• De-Esser – Reduce harsh sibilance in vocal recordings for clearer, more professional voice.
• Audio Compressor – Smooth out dynamic range; loud parts get quieter and soft parts get louder.
• Audio Merger – Join multiple audio files into one continuous track. Combine songs, podcasts, or voice memos.
• Reverse Audio – Play audio backwards for creative effects or language study.
• Ringtone Maker – Create custom ringtones, alarm sounds, and notification tones. Trim a section and save directly as ringtone or assign to contacts.
• Supported Input & Output: MP4, MOV, MP3, WAV, FLAC, AAC, OGG, WMA, M4A, ALAC, AIFF, AMR, AC3, Opus, CAF, DTS, WV, OGA, W64, VOC, SPX, IRCAM, MP2, GSM, and more.

WHO IS IT FOR?

• Content Creators – Extract background music from video clips, convert voiceovers to MP3, edit audio for YouTube, podcasts, or social media. Speed up or slow down without losing pitch.
• Students – Convert lecture recordings from M4A to MP3, trim long sessions, boost volume, and reduce classroom noise.
• Music Lovers – Change format of your music library, create ringtones from favorite songs, adjust pitch to learn instrument parts.
• Professionals – Clean up conference call recordings, remove echo from interviews, normalize audio for presentations.
• Podcasters – Edit episodes with cut, fade, equalizer, and noise reduction. Export in high-quality formats for distribution.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Choose your file – Import from device storage, gallery, music library, or via Wi-Fi transfer.
2. Select action – Convert format, extract audio, trim, apply effects, or make a ringtone.
3. Customize – Adjust parameters like bitrate, volume, speed, EQ, and noise reduction level.
4. Export – Save locally, share directly, or set as ringtone.

FAQ

How to convert MP4 to MP3? Tap “Convert”, select your MP4 file, choose MP3 as output, and tap the convert button. The optimized algorithm processes it quickly.

How to extract audio from a video? Use the “Extract Audio” option. Pick a video, select desired audio format (MP3, WAV, FLAC, etc.), and extract in seconds.


In short: the most complete audio converter, extractor, and editor for Android – all in one app. Whether you need to convert audio formats, extract sound from videos, trim clips, or create ringtones, this tool has you covered. Start transforming your audio today.
